name: Kugellager-Vertrieb Inntal GmbH

payment_behaviour.note: last 12m: 20 of 48 invoices paid >3 days late, max 7 days. Avg 2.9 days late; minor.

financial_health.signal: Family, credit 180 unchanged, equity 43.4%; healthy. Idle second shift.

notes: Asks avg 3.9%, settles ~2.4 pp lower; 6306 2026 asked 3.4, settled 0.0 (EV-2026-70640-360020).

situation: Austrian bearing distributor (EUR 37 m) holding 30% of the 6306 (EUR 4.20, cheaper than WZS 4.39) and 60% of the 6308. It already had idle capacity (second shift on hold). On 17 Oct 2026 it lost a large distribution contract, about a tenth of its volume, when a machinery group moved its bearing purchasing to a central European platform. It is now looking for new customers to fill its warehouse (news:20261017-S19). It already asks for our expected volumes to renew the 6306 agreement (expires 2027-06-30). Its second-source quote for 20,000/yr 6306 was EUR 5.04, far above its contract price.

pressures.evidence: Could take additional parts at short notice; second shift on hold.
Focus on customers with volume; renewal asks volumes.
Lost about a tenth of its volume after a machinery group centralised bearing purchasing; looking for new customers to fill its warehouse.

what_it_values: more volume to fill capacity and warehouse

likely_tradeables.give: move WZS-disengaging 6306/6308 share to Inntal at renewal
likely_tradeables.get: 6306 below EUR 4.20 or price fixed for contract term
likely_tradeables.why: needs to replace roughly 10% of lost volume

arguments_that_should_land.argument: Inntal lost about a tenth of its volume (news:20261017-S19). Our 6308 forecast is +16.0% and 6306 is +4.2%, which offers replacement volume in exchange for price.
arguments_that_should_land.why: links our volume carrot to its new gap

arguments_to_avoid.argument: Treat quote:7200004 (5.04) as its real level
arguments_to_avoid.why: it is a small-lot RFQ price; anchor on contract 4.20

arguments_to_avoid.argument: Openly gloat about the lost contract
arguments_to_avoid.why: cooperative family relationship; use the volume gap implicitly through the offer

update_notes.summary: Inntal lost a large distribution contract (about a tenth of its volume) and is actively seeking new customers to fill its warehouse (news:20261017-S19). This adds volume pressure and strengthens our position: offer a larger 6306/6308 share for a held or lower price at renewal.
